mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees and clear near Badger Ridge Middle School, with a Waning Gibbous moon visible in the sky.

City engineering reports are now available through October 2026, and the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is looking for your input on the US 18/151 Corridor Study with meetings scheduled for November 18 and 19.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy trivia at The Bogey Factory, live music at Paddy Mac's, or pizza night at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Main Street Trick or Treat event kicks off, followed by trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from October 22, a vehicle crashed into a Metro Bus on West Verona Avenue, resulting in a citation for failure to yield.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
